levels.title: Your first words
levels.description: Basic words, 3–5 at a time: greetings, food, family, numbers.
levels.speakingGoal: Recognise and say about 50 everyday words.

levels.title: Putting words together
levels.description: Join words into little phrases, then learn question words, small words and action words.
levels.speakingGoal: Say short phrases like "garam chai" and "mera ghar" and know the words sentences are made of.

levels.title: Your first sentences
levels.description: Use the words you know with one sentence pattern at a time.
levels.speakingGoal: Build your own simple sentences: "I am fine", "I need water", "Where is the shop?".

levels.title: Everyday conversations
levels.description: Greetings, introductions, family, food, shopping, directions and time.

levels.title: Natural conversation
levels.description: Past and future, requests, plans, feelings and casual Urdu.

levels.title: Real-world & advanced
levels.description: Travel, phone calls, problems, idioms and storytelling.
levels.speakingGoal: Keep longer conversations going with less help.

story.title: Summer in Lahore
story.text: You've just landed in Lahore to spend the summer with your Khala's family. Your cousin Bilal, his sister Ayesha, little Zara and Dada ji can't wait to meet you — but at home, everyone speaks Urdu. Leni, your teacher, will help you every step of the way.
